13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark palette with a well-executed blue/orange source-target highlight system and satisfying fade interaction, but the resting state is an undifferentiated hairball with no package-level color grouping to orient the viewer before hovering.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: Relational topology chart — baseline/scale rules don't apply; edge paths, cluster layout, and adjacency highlighting are structurally honest and data-driven, with only a minor intuitive inversion in the tension slider (high tension → beta=0.15 → less bundling, opposite to typical user expectation).
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider's `input` listener calls `linkSelection.attr('d', line)` on every tick — re-computing and mutating all ~80 bundled paths at up to 60fps with no RAF coalescing or debounce; all other criteria (no cross-view dispatch, no zoom/brush scales, no transitions, no touch handlers) are clean.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: 87 leaf nodes and 80 bundled edges are dense in static view, but the low-opacity rest state, strong blue/orange hover highlight with fade, and curveBundle tension management keep cognitive load acceptable — the chart is unreadable without hover but the hover interaction is well-designed for a form that inherently requires it.
